_help: Draft & Trade Ledger. Picks and trades are pulled automatically. Hand-enter only the verdicts. verdicts: key 'YEAR:R.SS' (e.g. '2026:1.01') -> {grade: hit|mid|bust, note}. Ungraded picks stay grey ('Too early'). Grade picks years later, once careers have played out. trades: key = Sleeper trade id (see data/<year>/transactions.json) -> {status: deceased|alive|pending, headline, cause, obituary, survived_by}. 'deceased' trades get an obituary card at the top of the Blockbuster Registry. drafts: key = season -> {label}. grading: auto-grades picks from data/stats/<season>.json after each of the first 3 seasons by position rank (hit = within 'hit' rank, mid = within 'mid' rank, else bust; picks after 'late_round' can't be busts). Hand-entered verdicts always override.
